FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

Its tools, materials and machines are the real ones of that trade; the element's own visual language (dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood) lives in the surroundings, light and materials, never in her clothes. SCENE (chosen):

Outfit: grunge — an oversized plaid flannel tied at the waist over a slip dress and combat boots
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body facing the camera; head turned to the side; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a glass test tube of coloured liquid upright between her fingers at chest height; it is all she holds.

EXPRESSION: brows level, eyes bright and steady, closed-lip smile with a firm mouth.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis

Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her element belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her element's palette, materials, patterns or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Fe) and atomic number (26) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
